GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from the Inside . Went Forward led x 1 length @ 700m. same to turn . Just off fence Straightening Up . had good battle for a while but run ended 150m and was swamped # led/peaked 200m
Jumped Well Went Forward to lead .5 Lengths 800m 1st .5 Lengths home turn 2nd Hard Ridden Outside Leader weakened badly final 200m # led/weak late

Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced wmtf Four Wide No Cover (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & in Four Wide @ 150m. Worked home OK in last 100m. # Wide/OK late.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat 1 length off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and weakened # 3 Wide trip
Jumped Ok sat 3l off, improved turn, took over Straightening Up and drew clear # had run/too good

Jumped well. Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide No Cover early . Worked to stay =lead 3 Wide midrace & held together =lead Five Wide on home turn. Pushed to lead @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Raced away in last 150m to win easily. # Worked/bolted in.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead Two Wide early . Stayed =lead Two Wide mmidrace & pushed along =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & faded in last 150m. # On-pace/faded.

Jumped well. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (3/4L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & held together & laid out Four Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 200m & fought on but no match in last 150m. # On-pace/tried hard.

Jumped Ok not bustled, settled 5l off on rail, ridden along turn saving ground, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, battled on strong to the line making good ground, just no match leader/winner # back/ran on
Jumped Well to lead half clear, held together turn, joint lead Straightening Up narrow lead passing 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on fairly late # led 150m

Began well. Pushed fwd to lead on rail by 3/4L early . Held lead on inside until held together Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & 1 length clear @ 100m. Faded late & grabbed on the line. # Led/nabbed late

Bumped @ start. Niggled early & raced 4th Four Wide No Cover (3L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Six Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & faded in last 200m # Worked & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and was carried in and bumped a runner. Rider reported that she was instructed settle in a prominent position, however, as runners to her inside showed superior speed she was obliged to race wide and without cover. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the filly to have a slow recovery.
